Grindcore/Goregrind/Brutal Death Metal/Noise band from USA, San Antonio, Texas.

They call their style Absurd DeathNoiseGrind.

The band is active since 1996.

The band released their first demo, (Savage Vaginal Shredding) in 1997.

The band recorded their first full-length album (Drowned in Rectal Sludge) during the week of December 12th, 1999 and subsequently released it March 22nd, 2000.

Topics the band deals with are Misogyny, Gore, Sex, Murder, Fetishism (early); H.P. Lovecraft (later).
